description: Day 20 sorted your mistakes into kinds. But that pile only holds the mistakes someone reported. Today is about the ones nobody reports.
line: A maths homework app's AI marks about 60,000 children's answers a week. A line added to stop "right answer marked wrong" complaints ("if it means the same, like 0.5 and 1/2, mark it right") cuts complaints from 85 a week to 52, while a random sample of 200, re-marked by a teacher, shows wrong answers marked right rising from 2 to 10 (about 3,000 a week, 1 complaint) and total mistakes from 7 to 13
title: Day 21 — Fewer Complaints, More Mistakes
